newsitem.title: USA: Whittman-Hart Q4 net up as revenues jump.
newsitem.headline: Whittman-Hart Q4 net up as revenues jump.

text.p: Whittman-Hart Inc said Tuesday a sharp increase in its revenues in the fourth quarter ended December 31 fueled a solid gain in earnings in the period.
The company said net income reached $2.1 million, or $0.10 a share, up from $232,000, or pro forma $0.02 a share in 1995.
Whittman-Hart said revenues rose to $25.3 million from $15.2 million in the fourth quarter one year ago.
The company said it added more than 150 clients in 1996 and boosted its professional ranks to more than 1,000 at the end of 1996 from 635 at the beginning of the year.
Its shares were trading down 1-3/8 Tuesday at 19-5/8.
